economic_mechanism: Temporary liquidity imbalance may mean-revert after conservative costs.
entry_rule_changes: Enter only after a completed session and never open a short position.
exit_rule_changes: Exit after five completed sessions or invalidation.
expected_failure_modes: Persistent news trends can prevent mean reversion.
feature_changes: Add a versioned five-session reversal feature.
hypothesis: A point-in-time five-session cross-sectional reversal feature may improve matched net returns.
invalidation_conditions: Net OOS effect is below the declared minimum.
placebo_tests: Shift the signal date by one completed session.
position_sizing_changes: Use capped long-only inverse-volatility sizing with residual USD cash.
signal_formula_changes: Rank the bounded reversal feature cross-sectionally.
stress_tests: Apply three times modeled execution cost.
why_current_model_failed: The synthetic parent does not represent short-horizon reversal.
